items.title: Wave-Based Room Acoustics Modeling with Accurate Sound-Absorbing Boundary Condition
items.excerpt: COMSOL compares local and extended-reaction absorber boundary models in wave-based time-domain room acoustics. In the example, local reaction assumptions materially changed decay and clarity metrics; the post also documents dG-FEM impulse-response normalization and notes GPU acceleration for the local-reaction formulation.

items.title: Agentic AI Within the Simulation Engineering Space
items.excerpt: COMSOL shows LLMs using its Java API and an agent creating an equation-based model, defining equations, running a study and generating visualizations from one prompt. The post also details Cosmon Nexus workflows for CAD cleanup, simulation setup, solver troubleshooting, sweeps, result evaluation and reporting.

items.title: Insights into the Future of RF and Microwave Technology
